summary: Walks the allocator-context linked list and decommits free pages (page-table entries holding 240) via VirtualFree(MEM_DECOMMIT), up to a remaining page budget a1. Each successful decommit marks the page-table entry -1, decrements the live page counter dword_8D41B8, and optionally lowers the context's lowest-free pointer v1[3]. If one context's entire page table becomes -1 (all 1024 pages free), the context itself is destroyed via sub_594A5E. Called per frame by CounterThreshold (00594bcd).

Per-context page loop: i runs 4190208 down to 0 in 4096-byte steps, visiting each 4KB page of the arena; each page-table entry is two DWORDs wide (v2 -= 2 per iteration).

VirtualFree((LPVOID)(v1[4] + i), 0x1000, 0x4000): decommit the 4KB page with MEM_DECOMMIT (0x4000); the page is only freed when the call succeeds.

Increment the freed-page counter v8 and decrement the remaining page budget a1; break out of the page loop when the budget reaches zero.
After each context: if at least one page was freed (v8) and the context's page-count entry v5[6] is -1, run the all-free confirmation scan.
Scan v6 = v5 + 8 across entries 1..1023, stepping v6 += 2, to confirm every remaining page-table entry is -1.
sub_594A5E(v5): destroy the entire allocator context when all 1024 page entries are free.
